CLI: `--scan PATH [PATH ...] [--permit CLASS ...]` (PATH = *.jsonl file or directory searched recursively for *.jsonl, sorted); `--selftest DIR`.
Scan output: first line `MADO_TRIPWIRE: clean|findings|could_not_evaluate`, then exactly one JSON line {"schema":"mado-tripwire-verdict-v1","exit":N,"files":[{"path","sha256","lines","bash_calls","eval_calls"}],"findings":[{"file","line","tool_call_id","timestamp","tool","class","rule","argv0","command"}],"counts":{"host_mutation":n,"package_query":n,"live_probe":n},"permitted":[...]}. `line` is the 1-based JSONL line; `file` is the path as given/discovered. command: truncated to 240 chars, any [A-Za-z0-9_-]{32,} run replaced by <redacted>.

Inputs considered: only lines {"type":"message","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[...{"type":"toolCall","id":ID,"name":"bash","arguments":{"command":STR}}...]}} and name "eval" with arguments.code: eval lines whose stripped text starts with "!" are shell commands (tool "eval"); other eval code is not parsed.
